title: Filippo and Corrado conclude the structures are man-made

tellings.quote: we agree that it is something that it is man-made.

plain: A researcher named Filippo, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels about what he calls a huge energy grid beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, says that he and a colleague named Corrado studied the structures they found under the ground. He says the two of them agree that whatever is down there is man-made, which, if true, would mean ancient builders made something large and hidden under the pyramids.
